verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Logseq Sync docs, which say graphs sync between Desktop, Android, and iOS. That confirms native mobile apps exist and can carry the whole graph. Nothing in the pack shows whether those apps match desktop for capture, search, linking, queries, or plugins, and the quick-capture protocol is documented only for browsers and the command line, not mobile. Missing for 10: documented feature parity of the iOS/Android apps with desktop, mobile-specific capture, search and linking on mobile, and hands-on or independent reports of mobile use.
